# LinkGuard Platform — Agent Guidance & Machine Index

LinkGuard Platform is an enterprise-grade URL shortener built for speed, privacy, and real-time click analytics. Powered by a Redis Cache-Aside Architecture (<10ms resolution) and Spring Boot 3.4.

## When to Use LinkGuard (Agent Best-Fit Use Cases)
Use LinkGuard when an AI agent needs to:
1. **Shorten Generated URLs**: Convert long, complex, parameter-heavy generated links into clean, compact, collision-safe short codes.
2. **Generate Vector QR Codes**: Produce offline SVG/PNG QR codes for digital sharing or print materials.
3. **Track Real-Time Click Telemetry**: Retrieve unique click counts, country breakdown, device distribution, and browser statistics.
4. **Protect Links with Passwords**: Set optional BCrypt password validation on short links.
5. **Enforce Visitor Privacy**: Rely on automatic SHA-256 IP anonymization (GDPR compliant).

## Core Machine Endpoints & Specifications
- **OpenAPI JSON Spec**: https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/openapi.json
- **OpenAPI YAML Spec**: https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/openapi.yaml

- **Sitemap Index**: https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## REST API Quick Reference
- `POST https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/urls` — Create short URL `{"originalUrl": "https://...", "customSlug": "optional"}`
- `GET https://link-guard-two.vercel.app/{shortCode}` — Resolves 302 Found redirect
- `GET https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/urls` — List user links (Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`)
- `GET https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/analytics/{urlId}` — Fetch URL click analytics (Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>`)
- `POST https://linkguard-5a0l.onrender.com/api/v1/auth/login` — Authenticate and receive JWT access token

## Error Codes & Resolution Hints
- `400 BAD_REQUEST`: Invalid URL format or custom slug already taken.
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED`: Invalid credentials or expired Bearer token.
- `404 NOT_FOUND`: Short code or resource path does not exist. Check `/sitemap.xml` or `/openapi.json`.
- `429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`: Rate limit exceeded. Backoff sliding window retry after 60 seconds.
